WITH counts AS (
  SELECT 
    r.ordervault,
    o.orderflow,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM riskandmargin r
  INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY r.ordervault, o.orderflow
),
status_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    orderflow,
    SUM(cnt) as status_total_count,
    COUNT(*) as num_combinations,
    1.0 / COUNT(*) as avg_share
  FROM counts
  GROUP BY orderflow
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    c.ordervault,
    c.orderflow,
    c.cnt,
    c.cnt::FLOAT / ss.status_total_count as share,
    c.cnt::FLOAT / ss.status_total_count - ss.avg_share as diff,
    ss.avg_share
  FROM counts c
  JOIN status_stats ss ON c.orderflow = ss.orderflow
)
SELECT 
  ordervault,
  orderflow as status,
  cnt as count,
  share,
  diff
FROM with_shares
WHERE share > avg_share
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Average share for a status is the arithmetic mean of individual shares (count / status_total) across all ordervault combinations for that orderflow, which equals 1 / (number of combinations for that status).
INNER JOIN drops riskandmargin records that have no matching order in the orders table (as explicitly stated in the request).
Comparison is strictly greater-than (share > avg_share), not greater-than-or-equal.
